item.title: Highway 312 stabilization project near Wakaw begins
item.description: Nicole Goldsworthy Local Journalism Initiative Reporter SaskToday.ca WAKAW — The Ministry of Highways is planning a $2-million construction project on Highway 312 to repair a landslide geo-hazard near Wakaw, with work scheduled to begin in February 2026. The project involves approximately 100 metres of resurfacing and the installation of sheet piles to stabilize the highway. item.description: It began as a simple idea in 2021, to bring creative connection to seniors in the Adult Day Program in the Herb Bassett Home and Pineview Terrace and on Sunday, residents celebrated its success. “The Quilt: Threads That Connect Us” celebrated how the program has grown to include poetry, songs and naturally a quilt.
